note: Cross Stitch's samplers for one band, built by tools/build_crossstitch.py from Hidden Word's answers (themselves drawn from wordfreq, Robyn Speer et al., CC-BY-SA 4.0). `words`: three across (rows 0/2/4) then three down (columns 0/2/4), folded; `shown`: the same as written; `start`: the 25 cells as dealt, row by row, '.' a hole; `min`: the fewest swaps that stitch it, solved exactly.
